manifestsWithoutConnector.filesystem: Not a @nimbus-dev/connectors connector. mesh.ts spawns @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem through bunx with no network entry.

readwise.reason: Ships as the signed extension com.nimbus.readwise (connector-catalog.ts), so its list is its own nimbus.extension.json, enforced through the run grant.

workday.reason: Per-tenant only. ensureWorkdayMcp falls through manifestForFirstParty's default-deny and adds the host of NIMBUS_WORKDAY_TENANT_HOST.

literalGaps.reason: The project link inside the User-Agent header value.

knownUnreachable.reason: onedrive_item_download fetches Graph's /content, which redirects to a pre-authenticated URL. A per-tenant <tenant>-my.sharepoint.com host is a Linux wildcard (*.sharepoint.com), and still fails on macOS. A consumer OneDrive download host has more than one label under any wildcard, so it fails where hosts are enforced on every OS. Listing and metadata work.
gcp_gke_workload_restart runs kubectl against the address get-credentials writes, which is known only per cluster and usually a bare IP. This tool fails where hosts are enforced.
az follows the cloud the owner set in its own config, which the gateway does not read. Only the public cloud is declared, so every azure tool fails on a sovereign cloud where hosts are enforced.

knownUnreachable.hosts: the cluster API server named in the kubeconfig
knownUnreachable.reason: The list is empty and no spawn site adds the server, so the policy is no-network on every OS already: kubectl tools cannot reach a cluster through the MCP connector. This forwarder changes nothing here. The gateway's own kubernetes-sync runs kubectl outside this sandbox.

knownUnreachable.hosts: registry.terraform.io, provider and backend hosts, api.pulumi.com, cloudformation.<region>.amazonaws.com
knownUnreachable.reason: The list is empty, so the policy is no-network already, and the hosts depend on each workspace's own configuration. This forwarder changes nothing here.

airflow.decision: phase3AddAirflowMcp adds the stored URL's host, labelled the owner's.

apple.reaches: caldav.icloud.com, then a p##-caldav.icloud.com partition; imap.mail.me.com:993 and smtp.mail.me.com:587.
apple.decision: IMAP and SMTP are added by ensureAppleMcp. Partitions p01 to p10 added to the fixed list, matching the connector's own nimbus.extension.json. A higher partition is a Linux wildcard (p*-caldav.icloud.com); on macOS an account outside p01 to p10 still has no calendar, and whether login reaches a partition host is unverified.

argocd.decision: phase3AddArgocdMcp adds the stored URL's host, labelled the owner's.

athena.reaches: aws CLI to athena.<region>.amazonaws.com; sts for credentials.
athena.decision: Endpoint prefix read from the CLI's botocore service model. Service host and regional STS are added at spawn from aws.default_region. With no region stored they are Linux wildcards on amazonaws.com and amazonaws.com.cn; on macOS every tool of this connector still fails with no region.

aws.reaches: aws CLI to ecs, lambda and ec2 at <region>.amazonaws.com; sts for an assume-role profile.
aws.decision: Every tool is a regional call and the fixed list named none of them, so the connector would have failed outright. Regional hosts are added at spawn from aws.default_region. With no region stored they are Linux wildcards on amazonaws.com and amazonaws.com.cn; on macOS every tool of this connector still fails with no region. The fixed list's iam, s3, ec2 and cloudfront hosts are not called by any tool; left in place and reported. An SSO profile's portal.sso.<sso_region> hosts are never declared.

azure.reaches: az CLI to management.azure.com; login.microsoftonline.com for tokens.
azure.decision: Both are declared. az webapp and az aks nodepool are ARM calls. az telemetry to other hosts is out of process and does not fail the command. Not run against a live tenant.

gcp.reaches: gcloud run to run.googleapis.com and <region>-run.googleapis.com; gcloud container to container.googleapis.com; oauth2.googleapis.com; kubectl to a GKE endpoint.
gcp.decision: run, container and serviceusage added to the fixed list, and the stored region's Cloud Run host at spawn. A Cloud Run call naming another region, or any call with no stored region, is a Linux wildcard (*-run.googleapis.com); on macOS it still fails. Cloud Run's reference says v1 requires locational endpoints; gcloud is not installed here, so no live run confirmed the exact hosts. serviceusage rests on recalled gcloud run deploy behaviour, not on a source read here. Workload-identity credentials would also need sts.googleapis.com, not declared. The GKE endpoint is in knownUnreachable.

github-actions.reaches: api.github.com; gha_run_log follows a redirect to Azure blob storage.
github-actions.decision: API host declared. The redirect target <account>.blob.core.windows.net is a Linux wildcard (*.blob.core.windows.net, which covers every Azure storage account, accepted by the owner); on macOS gha_run_log still fails.
